title: Amazingly Aromatic Uruguayan Tofu Bake
description: A tangy and silky plant-based dish featuring dark soy sauce, this Uruguayan-inspired bake is perfect for a monsoon evening. It combines the richness of tofu with the depth of dark soy sauce and the comfort of a warm bake.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dark soy sauce, olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the soy sauce mixture.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chopped onion and red bell pepper.
In a baking dish, create a layer of the onion and bell pepper mixture.
Add a layer of the tofu on top of the onion and bell pepper mixture.
Drizzle the tomato paste over the tofu.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of the onion and bell pepper mixture on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
